s.how: Pile 1kg cooked king prawns on crushed ice with lemon wedges. Mix 125ml tomato sauce with 1 tsp horseradish and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with buttered white bread, the way you would on the harbour.
Grill 8 beef sausages for 12 minutes, turning, until browned. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate until soft and golden. Wrap each sausage in a slice of white bread with onions and tomato sauce.

m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into chips and fry at 150C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager into a batter, dip 600g flathead fillets and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 125g mayonnaise with chopped pickles for tartare and serve with lemon.

w.note: an Aussie classic on the wrap party table
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar, shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 4 passionfruit and 250g strawberries.

d.note: an Aussie iced coffee for the crew
d.how: Brew 500ml strong coffee from 50g ground coffee and chill. Pour into 4 tall glasses with ice and 400ml cold milk, then top each with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a spoon of whipped cream.
